summary: Research authoritative sources and coauthor decision-ready documents.

skills.choose_when: The task is collaborative long-form writing, outlining, or revising a proposal, design doc, memo, report, or policy.
skills.avoid_when: Use a file-format skill as primary when manipulating DOCX/PDF/PPTX is the dominant task.
skills.name: coauthor-documents

skills.choose_when: The task turns observations into competing, falsifiable scientific hypotheses, discriminating predictions, or an experiment and analysis plan.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for a source-only fact lookup or a general document with no hypothesis or research-design decision.
skills.name: formulate-scientific-hypotheses

skills.choose_when: The answer requires current authoritative primary sources, precise citations, or fact/inference separation.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for purely local code inspection with no external or documentary research need.
skills.name: research-primary-sources
